facts.raw_span: A 52-year-old woman
history of long-standing diplopia
persistent vertical misalignment
MRI of the orbits revealed an anomalous band in the right orbit
surgically excised without improvement in motility
her diplopia remained stable in primary gaze
she was orthotropic in primary position
elevation deficit of the right eye
The globes were unremarkable with no measured proptosis
A right orbital linear soft-tissue lesion was noted medial to the medial rectus muscle
with enhancement and signal-intensity characteristics identical to those of extraocular muscle
it was unchanged from the previous study
